sections.content:
To show that an action is still happening or has been happening over time:

1. seguir + gerundio: 'still doing' (continuation):
• 'Sigo trabajando en el mismo colegio.' (I'm still working at the same school.)

2. llevar + tiempo + gerundio: 'have been doing for X time' (duration accumulated):
• 'Llevo tres meses viviendo en Madrid.' (I've been living in Madrid for three months.)

sections.title: Continuity Formulas
rows: ¿Sigues viviendo en Hanói? (Do you still live in Hanoi?)
Llevamos una hora esperando. (We've been waiting an hour.)
Sigo sin entender. (I still don't understand.)

items.spanish: ¿Sigues teniendo contacto con tus compañeros de clase?
items.english: Do you still keep in touch with your classmates?

items.spanish: Carlos lleva tres años aprendiendo español.
items.english: Carlos has been learning Spanish for three years.
